info.name: Food truck API
info.description: Orders, payments with test cards and deliveries. Run it with `npm test`, or import it into Postman with an environment from this folder and start the API with `npm start`.

exec: // A fresh Idempotency-Key per request, unless the request set its own.
// True of every response, refusals included.

item.name: 01 Smoke
item.description: Is the API up and does the main path answer? Stands on its own.

exec: pm.test('every item matches the menu item schema', () => { const item = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('schemaMenuItem')); pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({ type: 'object', required: ['items'], properties: { items: { type: 'array', items: item } } }); });

item.name: 02 Menu
item.description: Sold-out flag, set by staff. The folder puts the menu back as it found it.

item.name: Staff marks an item sold out

exec: pm.test('the churro is sold out', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.find((i) => i.id === 'churro').sold_out).to.equal(true));

item.name: Sold-out flag must be true or false
03 Orders (validation)
item.description: Money rules and malformed requests. The everyday refusals are in the CSV data run.

item.name: Tax is rounded once per order, not per item
Delivery adds a flat fee, and tax covers it
Two lines of one item count as one quantity
Body is not sent as JSON
04 Payments (test cards)
item.description: One order per story. The card number picks what the mock provider does.

item.name: Same key and body returns the first result
Same key with a different body
A paid order cannot be paid again
The paid order was charged once

exec: pm.test('the order was charged exactly once', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().paid_cents).to.equal(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('payOrderIdTotal'))));

item.name: Create an order for the timeout
Retry with the same key after the timeout
The retried order was charged once

exec: pm.test('the order was charged exactly once', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().paid_cents).to.equal(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('slowOrderIdTotal'))));

item.name: Create an order for the double charge
The doubled order keeps one charge

exec: pm.test('the order was charged exactly once', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().paid_cents).to.equal(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('twiceOrderIdTotal'))));

item.name: 05 Order flow
item.description: The chained story: each request hands an id to the next through variables.

item.name: Pick an item from the menu
Status must be a kitchen or driver step
Place a paid order to cancel
06 Access
item.description: No token, the wrong role, and somebody else's order.

item.name: Read an order with no token
Place an order with no token
A bad body with no token is still a sign-in problem
Read an order with a made-up token
A customer cannot change the menu
A customer cannot move an order
07 Data-driven
item.description: One request per data file, one iteration per row.

// CSV gives text: a number stays a number, and anything else goes in as it is, so bad rows reach the API.
